item.title: Low-Cost 40A, 1200V Solid-State Relay with Voltage Controller
item.description: This project describes a high-power solid-state relay (SSR) and AC voltage controller built using a BTA41-1200BW TRIAC (40A, 1200V) and MOC3041 opto-triac. Unlike conventional electromechanical relays or low-current SSRs, the circuit supports up to 40A continuous current and offers two operating modes: phase-angle AC voltage control (dimmer mode) and optically isolated ON/OFF solid-state relay mode.
